'''Arnett Moultrie''' (born November 18, 1990) is an American basketball player, most recently playing for the NCAA Division I [[Mississippi State Bulldogs]].

==High School==
In Arnett's junior season at [[Raleigh-Egypt High School]], he averaged 15 points, 8 rebounds and 2 blocks per game. In his senior season, he averaged 15 points, 8 rebounds and 4 blocks per game.<ref name=MississippiProfile />

==College career==

===Freshman season===
In Arnett's freshman at [[UTEP]], he averaged 8.8 points and 8.2 rebounds per game. He was also named to the Conference USA All-Freshman Team. Arnett averaged 13.2 points and 8.7 rebounds per game in the [[College Basketball Invitational]] as UTEP lost in the final round to [[Oregon State]].<ref name=MississippiProfile>{{cite web|title=Arnett Moultrie Profile|url=http://www.hailstate.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=16800&ATCLID=205027519|work=Mississippi State University Bulldogs Official Athletics site|accessdate=22 June 2012}}</ref>

===Sophomore season===
In his sophomore season at UTEP, Arnett averaged 9.8 points and 6.7 rebounds per game. In the Conference-USA Tournament, Arnett averaged 12.0 points per game and earned a spot on the all-tournament team.<ref name=MississippiProfile />

===Junior season===
Arnett was forced to sit out a season after transferring to [[Mississippi State University]]. In his first season playing for Mississippi State, Arnett averaged 16.4 points and 10.5 rebounds per game.<ref>{{cite web|title=Arnett Moultrie Profile|url=http://espn.go.com/mens-college-basketball/player/_/id/41183/arnett-moultrie|work=espn.go.com|accessdate=22 June 2012}}</ref>  He was also named to the All-SEC men's basketball team.<ref>{{cite web|title=2012 SEC Men's Basketball Awards Announced|url=http://www.secdigitalnetwork.com/NEWS/tabid/473/Article/232339/2012-sec-mens-basketball-awards-announced.aspx|accessdate=22 June 2012}}</ref>  On March 28, 2012 Moultrie decided to enter his name in the [[2012 NBA Draft]].<ref>{{cite web|last=Marcello|first=Brandon|title=Moultrie to declare for NBA Draft, end career at MSU|url=http://blogs.clarionledger.com/msu/2012/03/28/moultrie-expects-to-sign-with-agent-end-msu-career/|accessdate=22 June 2012}}</ref>
